verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs directly support this story: prompts are managed centrally with version control and labels for deployments across environments (docs-10), non-technical users can update prompts in the UI without code changes while apps auto-fetch the latest version (docs-6/22), and SDK-side caching ensures no latency penalty (docs-23/41). There's one HN comment noting prompt management was 'behind' compared to a competitor a couple months prior (langfuse-comm-11), a mild caveat but not a concrete failure of the core capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of production deployment workflows and rollback mechanisms beyond docs claims.
